subject: BrightPath: Go-to-Purchase ops check-in — PO vs Card vs Marketplace
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: James Li <j.li@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath — quick post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan

James — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and a proposed MAP so procurement has a clear runway. Please confirm ownership for each step (I've put suggested owners in parentheses).

Summary / ask: BrightPath wants to pilot Redwood Inference for triage routing on your clinical search flows. We discussed three commercial/billing paths: card for initial pilot, PO for enterprise commitment, and AWS Marketplace if you prefer vendor-central procurement. Need to confirm which you want to pursue.

Proposed procurement milestones (target dates are flexible):
- 1) Legal review of MSA & SOW (owner: BrightPath legal / Redwood legal) — target window: 10 business days (target complete: 2027-06-24)
- 2) Security review / evidence (owner: BrightPath InfoSec; Redwood to provide SOC2 and questionnaire) — target: 5 business days after docs received (finish by 2027-06-29)
- 3) Finance review & vendor setup (owner: BrightPath finance — Priya?) — target: 3 business days once SOW + invoice provided
- 4) PO issuance or card setup / Marketplace subscription (owner: BrightPath procurement/finance) — target: by 2027-07-01 for PO route

Attachments: BrightPath-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones we discussed), Redwood-SOC2-2026.pdf (SOC2 attestation), Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf (starter SOW + billing table).

Recommended playbook (our preference given timelines):
- Pilot on card to accelerate time-to-value while legal/security run in parallel.
- If you need centralized purchasing, we prioritize PO path with a target signature/PO issuance by 7/1.
- Marketplace works but tends to add 1–2 weeks for onboarding; good if you need cataloged vendor approvals.

Open items for you:
- Please confirm Finance contact (is Priya Anand the right owner?).
- Confirm whether BrightPath will accept Redwood’s standard MSA with redlines or needs BrightPath’s MSA.
- Any additional compliance docs beyond SOC2?

Next steps I’ll take: Ben will own pricing structure and PO language; Karthik will assist on legal handoffs. I’ll update the MAP and re-share once we confirm owners.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Rep | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: BrightPath-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood-SOC2-2026.pdf (PDF), Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf (PDF)

From: James Li <j.li@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Anand <priyaa@brightpathhealth.com>, David Morales <d.morales@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath — quick post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan

Vanessa — thanks for the clear summary. Couple of clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) Legal: we typically ask vendors to review against our standard MSA and provide a redline. Would Redwood be OK reviewing BrightPath’s MSA, or do you prefer to push Redwood’s MSA?
2) Security: SOC2 is helpful — can you also include the pen test summary (if available) and a short answers version of your security questionnaire? Our security team is time-constrained.
3) Marketplace: important question for procurement — if we go through AWS Marketplace, will that cover the PO requirement internally (i.e., will procurement accept that route instead of a vendor PO)?

Priya — looping you in for finance timeline / vendor onboarding.

If we can get a legal redline and security package by 6/21, we can likely keep to Vanessa’s dates.

Thanks,
James
Director, Platform Engineering | BrightPath Health
j.li@brightpathhealth.com

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 09:12 Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote: (see above)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: James Li <j.li@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Anand <priyaa@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath — quick post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan

Thanks James — answers inline below and a slightly tighter suggested timeline to help procurement plan: 

1) Legal MSA path: we can do either. Practical approach we’ve used: BrightPath sends your MSA, Redwood reviews and proposes limited redlines (payment, liability caps, data obligations). If you prefer Redwood’s MSA we can also run that but it sometimes triggers longer negotiation. Suggest: start with BrightPath MSA and let Ben/Karthik handle redline turnaround (target 3 business days).

2) Security docs: attaching Redwood-SOC2-2026.pdf. We also have a one-page security summary and a pen-test executive summary — I’ve included the one-pager inside the MAP spreadsheet and can send pen-test summary under NDA if needed. Karthik, can you prepare a short Q&A to drop into BrightPath’s questionnaire?

3) Marketplace vs PO: Marketplace often satisfies procurement catalog requirements but does not always substitute for PO for accounting teams — depends on whether your procurement needs a vendor-managed PO number. If procurement requires a vendor PO to tie to your internal ledger, the PO route is safer. Marketplace is fastest for cataloged purchases but may complicate custom SOW billing.

Revised timeline (aggressive):
- 6/15: MAP + packs shared (done)
- 6/16–6/18: BrightPath sends MSA redline + any security questionnaire items
- 6/21: Redwood returns redline + security Q&A (Ben/Karthik owner)
- 6/22–6/24: Finance/vendor setup and SOW finalization (Priya)
- 6/30–7/01: PO issuance / card setup / Marketplace subscription live

I’ve attached the updated MAP (BrightPath-MAP-v1.xlsx) with owner column filled. Ben — can you confirm discount tiers if BrightPath moves to a 12-month commitment (we discussed 15% off list on annual prepay)?

If BrightPath prefers pilot-on-card, we can skip PO until pilot completion and still provide account-level reporting.

Thanks all — I’ll also drop a DocuSign SOW link once Ben confirms final pricing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Rep | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: updated BrightPath-MAP-v1.xlsx, Redwood-SOC2-2026.pdf, Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, James Li <j.li@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Anand <priyaa@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath — quick post-call recap + proposed mutual action plan

Hi team — pricing / procurement notes from my side: 

- Pilot pricing (card): we can offer a 30-day pilot at a capped $3,000 invoice to make internal approvals easier. No long-term commitment required for pilot.
- Enterprise terms (PO): for a 12-month annual commit, we can extend 15% off list as Vanessa mentioned. We’ll include language in SOW for invoice frequency (monthly or annual) and standard PO acceptance terms (net 30).
- Marketplace: if you choose AWS Marketplace, billing flows through AWS and you lose a bit of discount due to marketplace fees; this route is simpler for procurement but may complicate revenue recognition for custom professional services.

I’ve uploaded a short procurement checklist and a sample PO template into the HubSpot deal notes (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567). For the SOW: suggested fields we need from BrightPath for procurement are billing address, vendor tax ID, PO contact, and remit email.

If Priya can confirm the vendor form and whether BrightPath requires vendor onboarding (W-9 equivalent / supplier form), I can prepare the SOW + invoice template to match.

Ben Carter
Commercial Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: Redwood-SOW-draft.pdf (updated pricing table), procurement-checklist.csv

Thanks Vanessa / Ben — this is helpful. Confirming: I’m the vendor onboarding owner and will own PO issuance for BrightPath. A few notes from finance: 

- Please send final SOW + invoice template and our vendor onboarding form (I’ve attached our standard vendor form to this reply).
- If Redwood can accept our MSA with only limited redlines to payment terms and liability, we can move faster. Please flag any hard stops.
- Target timeline: legal complete by 6/24, finance vendor setup completed by 6/28, PO issued by 7/01. We can shorten for pilot if you accept card initially.

I’ll review the procurement checklist on HubSpot and will upload BrightPath’s vendor form this afternoon. Once I have the SOW + vendor form matched, I can create the PO and provide a draft back to Vanessa/Ben for confirmation.

Best,
Priya Anand
Finance Manager | BrightPath Health
priyaa@brightpathhealth.com
